name: Nippon Life India Asset Management Ltd
about: Nippon Life India Asset Mgt. is engaged in managing mutual funds including exchange traded funds (ETFs); managed accounts, including portfolio management services, alternative investment funds and pension funds; and offshore funds and advisory mandates.(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No: 01)
keyPoints:
Part of Nippon Insurance, Japan[1]
The Company is promoted by Nippon Life Insurance Company, one of the leading private life insurers in Japan, with assets of over JPY 96 trillion as of FY25. The AMC has track record of ~30 years with 21.9 mn unique investors, over 1 in 3 MF investors in India invest with Nippon MF.[2]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 25.4% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 27.5%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 93.9%
cons: Stock is trading at 12.4 times its book value
